article.story: MACON, Ga. -- — Zaire Williams' 21 points helped Mercer defeat Appalachian State 75-67 on Wednesday. Williams also added five rebounds for the Bears (4-2). Baraka Okojie scored 16 points while going 3 of 11 from the floor. Armani Mighty had 12 points and shot 3 of 7 from the field and 6 for 8 from the line. The Mountaineers (4-4) were led by Kasen Jennings, who recorded 16 points. Alonzo Dodd added 11 points and six rebounds and Luke Wilson recorded 10 points and three blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
